messages.subject: Project Lyra – MSSA mark-up (Pennland)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Please find Pennland's mark-up of the MSSA attached (tracked). Our principal changes:

1. Availability raised to 99.7% (cl 4.1).
2. Service-credit cap up to 15% and deletion of the 'sole remedy' wording (cl 4.2).
3. RPI uplift capped at 3% p.a. (cl 5.4 / Schedule 2).
4. Liability cap raised to 200% of 12 months' Charges, with data-protection breaches uncapped (cl 10.3).

Happy to discuss.

Marcus Webb
Denham Lewis LLP
